description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of single channel elements, each preceded by a fill element of SBR data: the payloads follow no channel element, so decoders read none and the stream stays AAC LC at 22050 Hz.
findings: 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data that follows no single channel or channel pair element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg cannot decode the frames ("SBR was found before the first channel element"), so it reports no sample rate.
skip.decode: ffmpeg reports that SBR was found before the first channel element, the condition the fixture tests.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 does not read the stream: its SBR payload follows no channel element, and its trace holds one raw data block.
